title: Seal Beach weapons station sightings
place_text: Seal Beach Naval Weapons Station, Orange County, California

tellings.quote: civilians citing reports in Orange County California at the uh Naval uh Seal Beach Naval weapons station a series of bunkers again containing nuclear weapons uh there were local media reports of multiple sightings in March of 09 near this weapon storage

plain: In March 2009, local media reported several UFO sightings near the Seal Beach Naval Weapons Station in Orange County, California, near a set of bunkers that the teller says held nuclear weapons. The researcher Robert Hastings, who studies UFO reports at nuclear sites, tells it from those news reports and from what local civilians said, as one more case of UFOs showing up where nuclear weapons are kept.
